svg.title: Mocap Tradeoff
svg.desc: Shape recovery accuracy and runtime: each marker is the unweighted arithmetic mean of eight CMU MoCap sequences in main paper Table 3, page 7. Rotations are fixed for this stage. Runtime axis is logarithmic and error axis linear. Ours: 5.64125 seconds and 0.040475 error. OPM: 12.0825 and 0.039875. R-BMM: 14.22 and 0.0462625. TSM: 28.93875 and 0.0305125. BMM: 125.87 and 0.1244625. These are reported implementation timings, not normalized same-hardware estimates.
